name: Satyr
description: Nature spirits with the upper body of a human and lower body of a goat. Serving as Camp Half-Blood protectors who locate demigods and search for the lost god Pan.
origin: Greek wilderness spirits associated with Dionysus and Pan.
habitat: Forests, Camp Half-Blood, Council of Cloven Elders, Wild Woods
weaknesses: easily distracted by food and nature

name: Centaur
description: Beings with the upper body of a human and the lower body of a horse. Civilized centaurs like Chiron excel in medicine and archery, while wild Party Ponies hail from the American West.
origin: Ancient Thessaly in Greek myth; offspring of Ixion or Centaurus.
weaknesses: wild centaurs easily susceptible to alcohol and impulse

name: Nymph
description: Female nature spirits bound to natural elements, including dryads (tree nymphs), naiads (freshwater nymphs), and nereids (sea nymphs).
origin: Greek myth spirits of natural phenomena.
habitat: Forests, rivers, lakes, oceans, Camp Half-Blood strawberry fields
abilities: elemental control over assigned natural feature
weaknesses: life force bound to their specific tree or body of water

name: Pegasus
description: Winged equine steeds endowed with high intelligence, flight, and speech with children of Poseidon.
origin: Born from Medusa's neck when severed by Perseus.
habitat: Camp Half-Blood Armory Stables, Mount Olympus
weaknesses: vulnerable to physical weapons and monster fire

name: Fury
description: Bat-winged chthonic ministers of vengeance serving Hades, tasked with punishing crimes and guarding the Underworld.
origin: Primordial Erinyes born from the blood of Ouranos.
habitat: Underworld, Palace of Hades, Fields of Punishment
weaknesses: vulnerable to Celestial Bronze and Stygian Iron
bound to the direct orders of Hades

name: Hellhound
description: Massive canine beasts from the Underworld with abyssal black fur and red glowing eyes, capable of traveling through shadows.
habitat: Underworld, Fields of Punishment, Camp Half-Blood Woods

name: Skeleton Warrior
description: Undead infantry raised from the ground, frequently summoned by Hades or sowed from dragon teeth (Spartoi).
weaknesses: destroyed completely by consecrated sacred fire

name: Cyclops
description: One-eyed giants. Immune to fire; split between civilized divine forge-workers of Poseidon and aggressive feral island-dwelling man-eaters.
origin: Elder Cyclopes born of Ouranos & Gaea / Sea Cyclopes fathered by Poseidon.
habitat: Underwater Poseidon Forges, Sea of Monsters, Islands
abilities: immunity to extreme heat and fire

name: Dracaena
description: Reptilian humanoid women with two serpent trunks in place of legs, wielding spears and shields as officers in Kronos's army.
habitat: Princess Andromeda, Titan Vanguard Encampments, Labyrinth
weaknesses: vulnerable to Celestial Bronze and Imperial Gold

name: Laistrygonian Giant
description: Eight-foot-tall cannibalistic northern giants with tattooed skin and bronze armor, specializing in throwing fiery dodgeballs.
habitat: Northern Wilderness, Titan Army, Mortal prep schools in disguise

name: Empousa
description: Shape-shifting vampiric demonesses created by Hecate, having fangs, fiery hair, one bronze leg, and one donkey leg.
origin: Minions of Hecate in Greek folklore.
habitat: Underworld, Goode High School, Titan Outposts
weaknesses: illusions break under direct insult or cold water

name: Telekhine
description: Dog-faced sea demons with flipper hands, master metalworkers who forged Poseidon's trident and Kronos's scythe in Mount St. Helens.
habitat: Mount St. Helens, Depths of the Ocean, Titan Forge Camps
weaknesses: vulnerable to burst water surges and Celestial Bronze

name: Gorgon
description: Snake-haired female monsters whose gaze turns living beings to stone.
origin: Daughters of Phorcys and Ceto in ancient myth.
weaknesses: gaze can be reflected with polished bronze surfaces

name: Harpy
description: Avian-human female scavengers with bird claws and wings, acting as Camp Half-Blood's strict kitchen and curfew enforcement unit.
origin: Greek storm spirits and wind demons.

name: Siren
description: Bird-like sea enchantresses whose hypnotic songs lure sailors to shipwreck by projecting irresistible visions of their tragic flaws.
weaknesses: earplugs / wax deafening neutralizes song effect

name: Automaton
description: Enchanted metallic artificial constructs forged by Hephaestus or Daedalus, animated by divine magic or celestial bronze mechanisms.
habitat: Mount Olympus, Camp Half-Blood Woods, Crete, Labyrinth

name: Myrmekes
description: Giant, blood-red armored ant monsters about the size of German Shepherds. Living in underground nest colonies in deep woods, they spit toxic acid, possess venomous bites, and compulsively hoard gold and shiny metals.
origin: Ancient Greek myth, originating on the island of Aegina before being transformed by Zeus into the Myrmidons.
weaknesses: vulnerable to fire and intense heat
easily distracted by gold and shiny metal objects
